publicDomainStatus: Public domain. All volumes published before 1928; US, UK, and EU copyright terms expired.
sourcingNote: The primary Internet Archive digitisation of Weldon's Practical Knitter is held by the Knitting Reference Library (University of Southampton) under a CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 licence on their scans. That licence is incompatible with the platform's CC republishing policy (CC-BY / CC0 / PD only). A separately licensed or unambiguously PD-scan source is needed before images can be committed here. Candidates to check: HathiTrust (US university scans, often PD-unrestricted), British Library digital collections, or a fresh scan of a physical copy. See K-4.4 handoff for context.
